articles.title: Israel’s president gives Eisenkot the first chance to form the next government
articles.description: Israeli President Isaac Herzog has formally given opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot the first chance to form the next government. While complex coalition negotiations still lie ahead, this is a significant step in the former military chief’s effort to oust Israel’s longest-serving prime minister, Benjamin Netanyahu. It comes after elections were held in a deeply divided country scarred by the Hamas-led attacks of Oct. 7, 2023, and the multifront wars they triggered. The announcement doesn’t guarantee that Eisenkot will become the next prime minister. He has up to six weeks to form a government by securing alliances, a daunting challenge because the Oct. 27 election gave neither his bloc nor Netanyahu’s a clear majority in parliament.
